task.title: Scaffold the TypeScript Worker project in web/
task.description:
## Why
Everything else builds on a project that compiles, tests and runs locally.

## Steps
1. Create `web/` with a TypeScript Worker, a Wrangler config, and Vitest.
2. Serve a placeholder page through Workers static assets (the `assets` key in the Wrangler config) and one JSON route, `GET /api/health`.
3. Lay out the source so the report logic has no network or storage code in it: `web/src/engine/` for pure functions, `web/src/data/` for Sleeper and storage, `web/src/api/` for routes.
4. Add type-check and Vitest steps for `web/` to `.github/workflows/checks.yml`, next to the existing Python and Node steps.
5. Confirm `.github/scripts/public_data_guard.py` still passes.

## Done when
- `npx wrangler dev` in `web/` serves the placeholder page and `/api/health` locally.
- Pull request checks run the `web/` type-check and tests.
